title: Songs
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 1 Creative Activities; not yet checked by a CBC Creative Activities teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Choose action songs on topics the class is learning. Sing in unison; actions show the words.

skills.key_step: The child says what an action song is about and what it tells us to do, and names how to perform it: tune, clear words, actions, face.

floor.question: Show me the action for "wash your face".

steps: Do the actions the words say.
Ask: what does it tell us to do?

board.do: Sing "this is the way we wash our hands".

listen_for: we move our hands up and down
misconceptions.ask: What is the message of a song about brushing teeth?
misconceptions.repair: Ask: what does the song want us to do every day?

misconceptions.ask: The song says "clap your hands". What action do you do?
misconceptions.repair: Do each action as you sing its words.

listen_for: each child sings their own song
misconceptions.ask: What does singing in unison mean?
misconceptions.repair: Sing together; then each child sings alone.

misconceptions.ask: How do you sing an action song well?
misconceptions.repair: Compare a shouted line with a clear one.

checks.question: What does a song about brushing teeth tell us?
